subject: general
question: Who among the following represented India in the 11th BRICS Environment Ministers Summit, 2025?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Amandeep Garg**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Amandeep Garg** represented **India** at the **11th BRICS Environment Ministers Summit** held in **2025**.
 
• The **BRICS Environment Ministers Summit** is an annual meeting of ministers from the five BRICS nations (Brazil, Russia, India, China, and South Africa) to discuss and collaborate on environmental issues.
 
• The summit focuses on topics like **sustainable development**, **climate change mitigation**, **biodiversity conservation**, and the implementation of global environmental agreements.
 
• **Amandeep Garg** is a senior officer and an influential figure in India's environmental policy framework, ensuring India's effective participation in international environmental platforms.
 
• India has been actively participating in BRICS forums to address critical global environmental challenges and to enhance **cooperation among member nations**.
 
• The representation at such summits allows India to showcase its **initiatives, policies, and commitments** towards global environmental sustainability.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Bhupendra Yadav**__

 __
 
• **Bhupendra Yadav** is the **Union Minister for Environment, Forest and Climate Change** in India.
 
• While he plays a pivotal role in national and international environmental matters, he did not represent India at the **11th BRICS Environment Ministers Summit 2025.**
 
 
 
• **S Jaishankar**__
 __
 
• **S Jaishankar** is the **External Affairs Minister of India.**
 
• His role is primarily related to **foreign policy** and **diplomatic relations**, not directly associated with environmental summits like the BRICS Environment Ministers Summit.
 
 
 
• **Amit Shah**__
 
 
• **Amit Shah** is the **Union Minister of Home Affairs** in India.
 
• His responsibilities include matters related to internal security, law, and order, rather than representing India in environmental forums.
